children: Starknet has scheduled an unlock of up to 127 million STRK for investors and the team on 15 Dec 2026. The full amount equals about 1.62% of the circulating supply.
The unlock is part of a known monthly schedule. It adds a modest amount of STRK that investors and the team can sell, which limits the potential effect on the token's price.

title: Starknet: Scheduled unlock releases up to 127 million STRK - 15 Dec 2026
